description: This file contains Flutter widget classes for UI components of a Tic Tac Toe game, including background, player chip, mode toggle, and scoreboard, with styling and layout definitions.

classes.name: OceanBackground
classes.description: A container widget with a subtle gradient background, optional padding, and safe area padding.

classes.name: PlayerChip
classes.description: A customizable chip widget representing a player, with active state and icon styling.

classes.name: ModeToggle
classes.description: A toggle switch widget to select between game modes, with icon and label.

classes.name: ScoreBoard
classes.description: A scoreboard widget displaying scores for X, O, and draws, styled with Ocean theme.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for each widget, constructing Flutter UI elements.
